title: Blue Bridge
visualBrief: Compact Blue Bridge: split cast/concrete vault, granite abutments and splayed quay walls, ornate blue railing impressions, lanterns and representative parking marks. Detailed master remains independently reproducible.

nativeAxes.x: southeast across the short span toward Mariinsky Palace
nativeAxes.z: southwest along river toward the downstream concrete face

sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original926900-triangle/71885356-byte master reproduced exactly; independent24230-triangle medium-fi source simplifies vault ribs, casting and masonry.

reconstruction.notes: Arch heights, local rib and bolt spacing, ornament and lantern dimensions reconstructed from owner photographs. Published57+41m structural widths are nominal and overlap the95.4m cornice definition; model dividing seam is proportionally placed. Parking layout is clipped to the bridge footprint; surrounding square and monuments remain separate.

geographicProposal.notes: Two inspected street pictures establish blue quatrefoil/circle cast railing, plain inner rail, lantern context and plaza pavement. Existing vault dimensions are retained from the source. Standard viewer PMTiles Moika crossing and square confirm the short southeast crossing axis and broad downstream width. Retain29.4m crossing,95.4m cornice width and113.85m splayed-quay extent; nominal97.3m width is a separate definition. West/east road samples18.9794/19.0298m differ0.05m; source endpoint3.25m gives approximatebase15.7294m. Urban terrain includes bridge/roof imprint, so the source normal-water reference remains approximate. Narrow canal opening and bounded preview contacts remove that imprint; exact water stage/quay levels and parking layout are unverified.

appearance.identity: Broad Blue Bridge plaza with low split vault, splayed granite quays and blue circular/quatrefoil handrails.
appearance.exclusions: Surrounding square/buildings, Neptune gauge, vehicles and exact casting/text.

limitations: Two inspected street pictures establish blue quatrefoil/circle cast railing, plain inner rail, lantern context and plaza pavement. Existing vault dimensions are retained from the source. Standard viewer PMTiles Moika crossing and square confirm the short southeast crossing axis and broad downstream width. Retain29.4m crossing,95.4m cornice width and113.85m splayed-quay extent; nominal97.3m width is a separate definition. West/east road samples18.9794/19.0298m differ0.05m; source endpoint3.25m gives approximatebase15.7294m. Shared granite/concrete/painted metal are reused. Low tiers merge casting patterns and omit ribs; closer levels add quatrefoil/circle impressions and representative cast ribs. Exact curls, rib pitch, bolts, individual masonry, parking stripes and Cyrillic sign lettering are simplified; the sign is an unlettered plaque. Original master preserves detailed reconstruction.
No bespoke datum or parking-registration research. Physical-device timings remain unmeasured.
importReason: Preserve thin cables, rail frames and hardware across the full crossing; whole-object quantization loses these details.
